verdict.rationale: Egnyte publishes an llms.txt at egnyte.com/llms.txt. Several evidence items are sourced from it, covering product capabilities such as MCP access, the AI Agent Builder, AI Search and hybrid storage, so an agent can be pointed at it. The evidence shows only product-overview content, though, not agent-oriented technical or API documentation, and nothing confirms how complete it is or that agents use it well. missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented developer/API docs (e.g., llms-full.txt or markdown API references), documentation of the llms.txt scope and structure, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: enables any MCP-compatible AI client (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and others) to query Egnyte content natively
Custom agents can be built without code using the AI Agent Builder.
**AI Search** - semantic search across all connected content repositories using natural language rather than keywords.
